To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we develop a data driven streaming approach for clustering and end-to- end feature learning simultaneously that is able to detect novel clusters in streaming data.
we develop a data-driven approach to perform clustering simultaneously for streaming data and can adaptively detect and track novel clusters in emerging new data.
we develop a data driven adaptive nonparametric variational autoencoder (Adap-VAE) for streaming data that learns feature representation and clusters simultaneously.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development of an end-to-end deep learning framework for unsupervised streaming data clustering, and we hope our research can be useful for many applications in computer vision, natural language processing, etc.
the development of an online streaming data clustering model that can detect novel clusters in the data stream.

In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
we develop a data driven adaptive clustering approach for streaming data that performs end-to-end feature representation learning and clustering simultaneously.

we develop a data driven streaming clustering and feature learning approach with novel cluster detection capability, which can learn from streaming data without discarding past data and can adaptively detect and learn new clusters.

we develop a data driven streaming clustering approach that can simultaneously learn features and cluster assignments for streaming data and can adaptively detect and learn novel clusters in emerging streaming data without catastrophic forgetting.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we develop an adaptive nonparametric model to perform clustering and feature learning for streaming data.
we develop a streaming adaptive clustering method that can adaptively learn new clusters from streaming data while maintaining the ability of sample generation.
our approach is able to adaptively learn new clusters and detect novel clusters in streaming data while maintaining the quality of feature learning and clustering performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
AdapVAE is a powerful tool to perform unsupervised feature learning and adaptive clustering for streaming data.
the proposed AdapVAE model is capable of simultaneously learning feature representations, clustering assignments, and novel cluster detection for streaming data without the need of storing past data.
we show how a generative model can learn to adaptively detect new clusters in streaming data without forgetting past information.
